description: Scaffold the narrow ff-volume model crate and implement volume-model Requirements 1-11 (tasks 1-10): the Volume entity + VOLSER uniqueness, status/access-mode behaviour, deterministic emulated geometry, the SPACE allocation-unit model, extent accounting with the two DISTINCT failures (dataset x37-style Space_Abend and Volume_Full), volume capacity, derived reporting + VtocView, the DatasetVolume association with multivolume + uncataloged (VOL=SER+UNIT) resolution, the DEFINE VOLUME service + command CONTRACT (data only), and the metadata-only migration seam. ff-volume is a pure in-memory model crate (SQLite persistence belongs to ff-dscatalog in FEAT-002); it depends ONLY on ff-vfs + thiserror/serde/chrono and MUST NOT depend on ff-dscatalog/ff-dsalloc/ff-idcams (acyclic DAG). This FEAT is independent of FEAT-002's catalog changes and leaves the workspace buildable (new crate, no existing dependents yet). Steps follow plan.md items 1-10; read plan.md for the full module decomposition and per-item test lists.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/dataset-rationalisation-gate/rc-b5-ff-volume/context.json and this FEAT file FIRST, then plan.md items 1-10 and its 'Module decomposition' + 'Design decisions' sections.

plan.md item 1: create crates/ff-volume/Cargo.toml (deps ff-vfs path, thiserror/serde/chrono workspace; dev-deps proptest/pretty_assertions/tempfile; ASCII-only description, NO em dash) and src/lib.rs with crate docs + the pub mod list (error, volume, geometry, space, extent, dataset_volume, reporting, service, migration). Add "crates/ff-volume" to the root Cargo.toml members list near the other ff-ds* members. Verify: cargo check -p ff-volume compiles.

plan.md item 2 (TDD): error.rs VolumeError enum (thiserror, #[non_exhaustive]: SpaceAbend, VolumeFull, VolumeOffline, VolumeReadOnly, VolumeNotFound, DuplicateVolser); volume.rs VolumeId(u64)/Volser newtypes, VolumeStatus{Online,Offline}, AccessMode{ReadWrite,ReadOnly}, Volume struct (total_tracks/used_tracks/reserved_tracks), VolumeRegistry enforcing VOLSER uniqueness. Validates Req 1.1/1.2.

plan.md item 3 (TDD): status/access behaviour on Volume -- set_online/set_offline/mount/unmount, ensure_allocatable (Offline->VolumeOffline), ensure_writable (ReadOnly->VolumeReadOnly), and a resolution helper returning the first non-Online volume. Validates Req 2.1-2.4.

plan.md item 4 (TDD): geometry.rs GeometryProfile + DEFAULT_BYTES_PER_TRACK=56664 + DEFAULT_TRACKS_PER_CYLINDER=15; deterministic ceil conversions tracks(bytes)/cylinders(tracks)/bytes_of(tracks) with integer math. Validates Req 3.1-3.4, 11.1.

plan.md item 5 (TDD): space.rs UnitKind{Trk,Cyl,AvgRec{avg_record_len}} + AllocationUnit{kind,primary,secondary} + primary_tracks/secondary_tracks via GeometryProfile. NO SPACE string parser (that stays in ff-dsalloc). Validates Req 4.1-4.5.

plan.md item 6 (TDD): extent.rs Extent + DEFAULT_MAX_EXTENTS=16 + ExtentSet.accommodate implementing the design decision tree (fit / acquire secondary / x37 SpaceAbend at max_extents with prior content intact / VolumeFull consuming no extent). Validates Req 5.1-5.5, 6.1-6.4.

plan.md item 7 (TDD): volume.rs capacity accessors total/used/free_tracks + charge/release rejecting with VolumeFull when free<requested; wire extent.rs to charge only after confirming free space. Validates Req 7.1-7.4.
plan.md item 8 (TDD): reporting.rs DatasetSpaceReport + VolumeSpaceReport + VtocView, derived in O(n) extents, no byte scanning. Validates Req 8.1-8.4, 11.2.
plan.md item 9 (TDD): dataset_volume.rs DatasetVolume + DatasetVolumeSet (ordered, multivolume) + resolver honouring Online check + resolve_uncataloged(volser,unit). Validates Req 9.1-9.6.

plan.md item 10 (TDD): service.rs VolumeService.define_volume(DefineVolumeRequest) with duplicate-VOLSER rejection + resolution seam (documented as the RC.B.6 DatasetAccess seam, NOT built) + command CONTRACT data (DEFINE_VOLUME_COMMAND const + param descriptors, NO ff-command wiring, NO WorkspaceContext); migration.rs volume_over_repository + seed_dataset_volumes building metadata with NO byte movement. Validates Req 10.1/10.3, 11.3.
Keep every .rs under 400 non-test lines (split per the decomposition) and each test module under ~200 lines (sibling *_tests.rs if larger).

Run scoped checks via the pwsh7 wrapper: cargo check -p ff-volume; cargo test -p ff-volume; cargo clippy -p ff-volume -- -D warnings; cargo fmt. Fix any failures attributable to this FEAT and rerun until clean.

Set this FEAT status to completed and record in findings: the exact ff-volume public types/modules created (so FEAT-002 imports the right names), the VolumeError variants, and any naming note (e.g. ff_volume::AccessMode vs the existing ff-dscatalog vsam AccessMode). Commit nothing (NO commit -- leave uncommitted).

PUBLIC API FOR FEAT-002 TO IMPORT (re-exported from ff_volume crate root in lib.rs; also addressable by module path):
- ff_volume::error::VolumeError (thiserror, #[non_exhaustive]). Variants: SpaceAbend { dataset_id: u64, reason: SpaceAbendReason }, VolumeFull { volser: String }, VolumeOffline { volser: String }, VolumeReadOnly { volser: String }, VolumeNotFound { reference: String }, DuplicateVolser { volser: String }. NOTE the SpaceAbend (dataset x37) and VolumeFull (volume capacity) are DISTINCT variants (Req 5.5/7.3), and the Volume_Full path consumes no extent (Req 7.4).
- ff_volume::volume: VolumeId(pub u64), DatasetId(pub u64), Volser (opaque; Volser::try_new(impl Into<String>) -> Result<Volser,VolumeError> uppercases + rejects empty; .as_str()); VolumeStatus { Online, Offline } (#[non_exhaustive]); AccessMode { ReadWrite, ReadOnly } (#[non_exhaustive]); Volume (fields private; Volume::new(VolumeId, Volser, storage_uri: impl Into<String>, total_tracks: u64), builders .with_display_name / .with_reserved_tracks; accessors volume_id/volser/display_name/storage_uri/status/access_mode/total_tracks/used_tracks/free_tracks; mutators set_online/set_offline/mount/unmount/set_access_mode; guards ensure_allocatable()->Result, ensure_writable()->Result; capacity charge(u64)->Result (VolumeFull, no mutation on fail), release(u64)); VolumeRegistry (new/define(Volume)->Result<VolumeId,VolumeError> enforcing VOLSER uniqueness, len/is_empty, find_by_volser/find_by_id/find_by_id_mut, iter, ensure_all_online(&[VolumeId])->Result returning first offline/not-found).
- ff_volume::geometry: GeometryProfile (Default = 3390-style; new(bytes_per_track,tracks_per_cylinder) clamps >=1; bytes_per_track()/tracks_per_cylinder(); tracks(bytes) ceil, cylinders(tracks) ceil, bytes_of(tracks)); consts DEFAULT_BYTES_PER_TRACK=56664, DEFAULT_TRACKS_PER_CYLINDER=15.
- ff_volume::space: UnitKind { Trk, Cyl, AvgRec { avg_record_len: u64 } } (#[non_exhaustive]); AllocationUnit { kind, primary, secondary } (pub fields; new(...); primary_tracks(&GeometryProfile)->u64; secondary_tracks(&GeometryProfile)->u64). NO JCL SPACE string parser here (stays in ff-dsalloc).
- ff_volume::extent: Extent { dataset_id: DatasetId, volume_id: VolumeId, sequence_number: u32, allocated_tracks: u64, used_bytes: u64, locator: String } (pub fields); SpaceAbendReason { MaxExtentsReached, CapacityExceeded } (#[non_exhaustive]); const DEFAULT_MAX_EXTENTS: u32 = 16; ExtentSet (new; extents()/extents_used()/allocated_tracks()/used_bytes()/allocated_bytes(&geom); allocate_primary(DatasetId,&AllocationUnit,&geom,&mut Volume)->Result; accommodate(DatasetId,target_used_bytes: u64,&AllocationUnit,&geom,&mut Volume,max_extents: u32)->Result implementing fit/secondary/x37/VolumeFull decision tree).
- ff_volume::reporting: DatasetSpaceReport { extents_used, extents_remaining, tracks_in_use, cylinders_in_use } (derive(&ExtentSet,&geom,max_extents)); VolumeSpaceReport { total/used/free tracks + cylinders, extents_allocated } (derive(&Volume,&geom,extents_allocated)); VtocView { volume: VolumeSpaceReport, datasets: Vec<(DatasetId,DatasetSpaceReport)> } (derive(&Volume,&geom,&[(DatasetId,ExtentSet)],max_extents)). All O(n) in extents, no byte scan.
- ff_volume::dataset_volume: DatasetVolume { dataset_id, volume_id, sequence_number: u32, is_primary: bool, locator: String } (pub fields); ResolvedVolume { sequence_number: u32, volume: Volume, locator: String }; DatasetVolumeSet (new/add(DatasetVolume) keeps sequence order/rows()/len/is_empty/resolve(&VolumeRegistry)->Result<Vec<ResolvedVolume>,VolumeError> with Online check); free fn resolve_uncataloged(&Volser, unit: &str, &VolumeRegistry)->Result<ResolvedVolume,VolumeError>.
- ff_volume::service: VolumeService (new/registry()/define_volume(DefineVolumeRequest)->Result<VolumeId,VolumeError> dup-VOLSER reject + auto-increment ids from 1/resolve_dataset(&DatasetVolumeSet)->Result as the RC.B.6 DatasetAccess seam, documented NOT built); DefineVolumeRequest { volser: String, display_name: Option<String>, path: String, capacity_tracks: u64, status: VolumeStatus }; command CONTRACT data only: consts DEFINE_VOLUME_COMMAND="DEFINE VOLUME", VOLUME_LISTING_COMMAND="LISTVOL", VTOC_COMMAND="VTOC"; descriptor structs DefineVolumeParams/VolumeListingParams/VtocParams each with an associated const CONTRACT. NO ff-command wiring, NO WorkspaceContext.
- ff_volume::migration: fn volume_over_repository(VolumeId, root: &str, volser: &str, capacity_tracks: u64)->Result<Volume,VolumeError>; fn seed_dataset_volumes(&[(DatasetId,String /*storage_path*/)], VolumeId)->Vec<DatasetVolume> (locator=storage_path, sequence 1, is_primary true, no byte movement).

NAMING NOTE for FEAT-002: ff_volume::AccessMode { ReadWrite, ReadOnly } is a DIFFERENT type from the existing ff-dscatalog::vsam_service::AccessMode. When ff-dscatalog imports the volume one, use a qualified path (e.g. `use ff_volume::AccessMode as VolumeAccessMode;` or refer to it as ff_volume::AccessMode) -- do NOT glob-import ff_volume::* into a module that also uses the vsam AccessMode, or the names will shadow. Likewise ff_volume::VolumeId / ff_volume::DatasetId are the newtypes ff-dscatalog should map its row ids to/from.
